summary: Quantum static spherical clock: Birkhoff gives a static Schwarzschild exterior with Killing time equal to asymptotic proper time. The ADM Hamiltonian is a physical Dirac observable generating that flow. Duhamel's principle bounds quantum vector error by T*||V|| on the prepared one-body sector. This is a symmetry-reduced quantum gravitational relational clock, not full quantum GR.
